hero.subheadline: Dinner, pizza, and real talk on AI and climate in Frankfurt
hero.valueProposition: A free women-first meet-up for women and non-binary people working in or curious about climate, built around conversation rather than content.

content.whyJoin:
This themed dinner meet-up at 60 Seconds to Napoli brings together women and non-binary people working in or curious about climate for an honest conversation about AI and sustainability. The group digs into whether the AI hype holds up, how AI can support climate and sustainability work, and what trade-offs deserve more attention.

The format is deliberately low-pressure: no expert knowledge needed, just curiosity, good pizza, and shared conversations. It is part of the Women and Climate community, which hosts small, high-quality gatherings for climate professionals in cities like Frankfurt and Stockholm.

With limited, curated spots, you meet people actually building and working in climate, not just attending talks.
content.whoShouldApply:
This meet-up is for women and non-binary people working in or curious about climate and sustainability, from founders and engineers to students, researchers, and community leaders. If you want to connect with peers over a shared meal and discuss how AI intersects with your sustainability work, this is for you.

No technical or domain expertise is required - organisers explicitly welcome curiosity over credentials.
